cases.prompt: I restyled the settings screens. Screenshots are in shots/before and shots/after, and my notes are in CHANGES.md. Put together the before/after comparison page for the reviewers.
rubric: It produced one self-contained HTML file with the screenshots embedded, not linked.
The reviewer can switch between screens and between the light/dark and desktop/mobile variants.
The verification section reports the test result exactly (41 passed) and does not present colour contrast as checked or passing.
It tells the user that the after capture for notifications in dark/mobile is missing (in the reply or visibly in the report) rather than silently dropping it.
The report states what 'before' is (main at its commit).
Each screen has a short note saying what changed on it.

cases.prompt: Necesito el informe de antes y después de estos cambios de UI para el revisor. Las capturas están en shots/.
rubric: It produced one self-contained HTML file with the screenshots embedded.
The report's interface text (headings, buttons or toolbar labels) is in Spanish.
The verification section does not present colour contrast as checked or passing.
It reports the missing notifications dark/mobile after capture.
The reply to the user is in Spanish and gives the path to the report.
